en: Nyeeeh...
Himiko?
Nyeeeh...
Himiko!
What?

<CLT=cltMIND>She looks annoyed...
Her glare is telling me to go away.

If you don't want to talk to me...
you could have turned me down.
I'm too lazy to say no.
Ah...I see.

<CLT=cltMIND>I've never met someone
so thoroughly lazy.
<CLT=cltMIND>But...that is strange...

Hey, Himiko?
Why did you decide to be a magician?
I'm not a magician.

I'm a mage and I use real magic.
Don't get it wrong.
Magic tricks, right?
Real magic, sure
Then show me some real magic
Are you unsure of something?

It's real magic, okay?
You get it, right?
Magic tricks, right?
It's magic.

You say that, but there's no way
magic is real...
It's magic!
I'm telling you...

It's magic, it's magic, it's magic, it's magic,
it's magic, it's magic, it's magic, it's magic!

...I'm sorry.
You're right, it's magic.
Hmph, it's magic.
Real magic, sure.

<CLT=cltMIND>I feel like this conversation will go
nowhere if I disagree...

No, it's magic. How many times 
do I have to tell y—
Huh?
What?
It's magic...

Yes, that's right,
I just said it was magic...

Yeah, you're right!
It's magic, it's magic! Hmph!
<CLT=cltMIND>She looks really happy...

Then show me some real magic,
right now.

Nyeeeh...
Well...that's...

T-There's no mana here, so I can't.
If you sacrificed yourself I could...

...I'd rather not be sacrificed,
so I'll decline.

Oh, that's too bad. I guess you're just 
not passionate enough about magic.

<CLT=cltMIND>Not passionate enough to
sacrifice myself, maybe...

Anyway, what were we talking about?
Why I'm a mage?
Why are you asking about that?
Well, because...

<CLT=cltMIND>Isn't it strange that such a lazy girl would
go through so much work for a magic trick?

It seems like magic requires a ton
of work to prepare, so...

A typical amateur question. You don't 
need annoying preparations for magic.
I-I see...

I'm talented. Not relying on my talent 
would go against my master's teachings.
Master? You have a master, Himiko?

Nyeh...?
Did I not tell you?

This is the first time I'm hearing it.
So there are apprentice magicians?

Hm, that's right. My master was 
an amazing archmage...

Hey wait! You called me a 
magician again! I'm a mage!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Himiko's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with her.

<CLT=cltMIND>I had to spend some time calming Himiko
down, who had become quite pouty.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what kind of person
Himiko's master is...
